info.title: TED Tenders Daily: EU procurement notices from Tenders
info.description:
Which EU tenders were published today? Returns TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) notices with buyer, CPV, value, deadline and source link.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper
Author: Public Records.
